units: Keth. 8ᵇ כמִשְׁתֵּה ראשונים וכ׳ as those before you drank (the cup of grief) &c.—Esp. feast, wedding meal &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:10">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> <he>מ׳ גדול מִשְׁתֵּה גדולים</he> ‘a great feast’ (<cite ref="Genesis 21:8">Gen. XXI, 8</cite>) a festive gathering of great men.
<cite ref="Ketubot 4a">Keth. 4ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>שבעת ימי המ׳</he> the wedding week.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67b:15">Sabb. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>עשה מ׳ לבנו</he> gave a feast in honor of his son.
<cite ref="Ketubot 8a:6">Keth. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>נערים ממ׳ נגינתם</he> the voices of the youths singing at their banquets.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>בית המ׳</he> (the house of a) wedding.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1:25">Deut. R. s. 1</cite>, end; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִשְׁתָּאוֹת</he>, <he>מִשְׁתָּיוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 7:8">Ruth R. to IV, 2</cite>; Y. Keth. I, 25ᵃ <he>מכאן לבית הזה שהממנים … בבית מ׳ וכ׳</he> from here (Ruth l. c.) this house (of the Nasi) learned to ordain elders at its banquets.
